text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek, 30 beach sprints
is just way too brutal~~!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the ground pulls at your legs, don't it?
That means less recoil, so it's easier on the joints! Run, run! All the way to the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, shall we start the next training session?
Tsuyoshi, shall we get started on the next training session?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah! Y-Yes! Um, tire pulling and beach sprints—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: That'll be 5 sprints~. Let's start with the 10kg tire pulls.
choice_data_list: Let's build you up in a well-balanced way.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaah♪ This rice is hitting the spot~~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun!
Your training partner today was El-El after all!
Exhausted, worn out—it's only natural, *deeesu*!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, is everyone doing the test of courage after this?
Come on, let's do it~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Whenever you propose something, it always feels kinda fishy...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. But it will certainly be an unforgettable night.
What will you do, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A... A test of courage, huh...
Hmm... hmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna join in!
I wanna make lots of summer memories
and tell Mum all about everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right, Tsuru-chan—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry!
There's something I want to do in my room!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Have fun on the test of courage, everyone!
Thanks for the food!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …………Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Rudolf takes the lead! The crowd goes wild!
A giant crimson blossom blooms brilliantly over Kyoto Racecourse!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (――President Rudolf's "Kikka-sho.")

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (This is the race that made me admire the President in the first place...)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —“Absolute”...

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true. Definitely!
This Umamusume is definitely strong!

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text:
—"They say that 'the strongest Umamusume
wins the Kikuka Sho,' after all!"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text: "Symboli Rudolf's victory was absolute! After all, she is an Umamusume for whom 'absolutes' truly exist!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously... no matter how many times I see it, she's so strong.
She really is... "absolutely" strong...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Different from me...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, whaaaaat~!? What's this all of a sudden!?
Saying that like it's a joke..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
..................H-Hold on...
Why is my strength... Mmh—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tsuru-cha—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "No! I can't... stand up...!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —...Tsuru-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san is asleep.
I've finished giving her a full examination.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...I believe the cause is fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
......
Trainer, could we talk about the future?
choice_data_list: ...Indeed. Regarding how we follow up from here—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: No, not that one.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Why don't we set a goal other than the Kikuka Sho for her next race?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho takes place in late October.
Tsurumaru-san should be recovered by then.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I've come to learn a lot more about racing.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is 3,000 meters long.
It is the longest of all Classic-tier GⅠ races,
and requires scaling hills twice during the race.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: A war of attrition that saps both the physical and mental strength of the challengers. —That's why only the strongest Umamusume survive.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...I want to see her keep on running. Even if that once-in-a-lifetime dream won't come true. For her—"
choice_data_list: Still, the Kikuka Sho is the final—!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: However, I can only guarantee up to 1800m!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
This is no longer about winning or losing!
As a doctor, as someone who protects the future, I—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Even you... must know that, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...I can hear the voices of Trainer and the old master.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(They were arguing with each other.
With such terribly... worried voices.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Those two, who were such close friends... are desperately trying to protect my body and heart from breaking.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...For someone like me...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...It's because of............

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...! Tsurumaru-san,
are you awake?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yes! I can walk totally fine! I can get back to my room by myself!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, thank you for taking care of me.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank gooooodness! Tsuru-chan!
You can walk again!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here at this hour...?
As for a test of courage—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I can't go to that!
My friend just collapsed!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I was so, so worried—!!
(Drip... drippity-drip...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …………Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
D-Does something hurt?
Let's head back to the infirmary—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...N-No.
That's not it... It's not...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —President, what about your "absolute"?

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text: "Symboli Rudolf's victory was absolute! After all, she is an Umamusume for whom 'absolutes' truly exist!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No one worries about me.
Because... I'm "absolute."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Then why does everyone only ever worry about me?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...!
U-Uuuu..., uuuuuuuuuuu...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaahhhhhhhhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...I understand. I knew it all along.
Because I—don't have it.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Because there are no "absolutes.")

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Once she sets her mind on winning,
this Umamusume is an absolute force!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —An "absolute" truly existed in this world.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Not everyone in this world
has an 'absolute' like that, though."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I have witnessed the "absolute."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "That Umamusume 'never' lost. No matter who challenged her, she always came out on top."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: There were so many other "absolutes" as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've watched the Umamusume who believed in "the absolute"—
—and grasped it with their own hands.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Still, to me...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: No matter how hard I tried.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: No matter how much support I received.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: None.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I was just pretending not to see it.
Because if I didn't pretend it was there, I couldn't even believe in myself."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I knew it all along.
Living things crave because they are "lacking."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You want to eat because you're hungry.
You want to sleep because you lack rest.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's why――because I "didn't have it," I yearned for it.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I was just an Umamusume who wanted
to believe there was an 'absolute' within myself too."
The next day, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi developed a high fever.

Training was immediately changed to a day off.
...The discussion about future plans was also postponed.
